policy: For original ordinary English printings: default left through Alliances; right from Mirage through Scourge, core sets 5ED/6ED/7ED, and Portal; left again from Eighth Edition. Use an explicit set list, not release-date inference for later retro treatments. Explicit paragraph alignment and centering win.
limitation: Scan review establishes a shared alignment rubric, not exact typography or whole-set validation. Inline packing and manual indentation can still require printing-specific review. Later retro reprints and supplemental sets are not inferred from release date.
